content:
Laredo ISD parents got the call no one wants on Tuesday morning: every campus in the district was on “secure status.” By the afternoon, police said they had their suspect — a 14-year-old girl, now facing a felony terroristic-threat charge, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The online threat, directed at an unnamed campus, surfaced Tuesday morning. The FBI’s Laredo Resident Agency flagged it to the Laredo Police Department’s Texas Anti-Gang Unit, which tracked down where the threat was posted, according to the Times.

Investigators identified the girl as the primary suspect and interviewed her with a parent’s full cooperation. That parent consented to a search of the home — where officers found a loaded 9mm handgun in the rear of the residence, the Times reported.

After consulting the Webb County Attorney’s Office, investigators charged her with “terroristic threat: place public fear serious bodily injury,” a third-degree felony. She was taken to the Webb County Youth Village. Police say there is no current threat to any school, and the case remains under investigation.

The district placed all campuses on secure status around 8:15 a.m. after parents received the notification call, and lifted it just before 9 a.m. An LISD spokesperson told the Times: “We received a rumor of a threat, and that is the reason all the schools were placed on secure status. This is not a lockdown, but a secure status.” Secure status is a precaution for a potential threat or hazard outside the building — police activity nearby, criminal acts in the neighborhood, a dangerous animal — not a lockdown inside the school.

For a district that serves thousands of Laredo families — and one already under the microscope this election season, with trustee races on the ballot — the speed of the resolution is the story: a threat posted online in the morning, a suspect in custody by the afternoon.

excerpt: A 14-year-old girl was arrested on a felony terroristic-threat charge Tuesday after an online threat put every Laredo ISD campus on secure status; a loaded 9mm handgun was found at her home, police say.
title: 14-Year-Old Charged With Felony Terroristic Threat After Online Post Puts All LISD Campuses on Alert
